Cono uses FFmpeg and FFprobe as helper executables to inspect and extract
embedded subtitle streams. These helpers do not replace Chromium playback.

Windows helper builds:
- FFmpeg 6.1.1 essentials from Gyan, distributed by ffmpeg-static 5.3.0.
  Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/e38092ef93
  Build details: FFmpeg-build.txt
- FFprobe build 20230213-2296078 from Gyan, distributed by
  @ffprobe-installer/win32-x64 5.1.0.
  Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/2296078

Both Windows binaries are distributed under GPL v3. The license text is
included in FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt. Upstream build information and source links:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
https://ffmpeg.org/

The npm wrappers and other dependencies retain their respective licenses.
